description: Source code implementing JNI environment extension for Android, managing thread-specific JNI environment, class loader, and bridge object references.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes JNI environment extension, sets up thread-local storage, retrieves Java VM, and stores global references to class loader and bridge object.

methods.name: OnThreadShutdown
methods.description: Detaches current thread from JVM if previously attached.

methods.name: Get
methods.description: Retrieves or attaches JNI environment for current thread.

methods.name: GetStarboardBridge
methods.description: Returns the global reference to the starboard bridge object.

methods.name: FindClassExtOrAbort
methods.description: Finds Java class using class loader, converting class name from slash notation to dot notation, aborts on exception.
